messages.home.title: Welcome

messages.preview.ttmlHorizontal: Native TTML horizontal-text preview; ruby and broadcast stroke are not yet rendered.
messages.preview.ttmlRuby: Native TTML horizontal ruby preview; annotations use 0.5 scale and base-run centring. Full B62 ruby placement is still pending.
messages.preview.ttmlVertical: Native TTML basic vertical-text preview; explicitly associated ruby is rendered at 0.5 scale. Complete glyph-orientation rules and broadcast stroke are not yet rendered.
messages.preview.structuralOnly: Structural TTML/B62 preview; no native text plane is available for this instant.
messages.preview.missingGlyphs: {0} glyph(s) are not present in the bundled ARIB font and were left blank.
messages.preview.mappingDescription: The Rust backend maps libmpv media time to the caption project timeline. The WebView does not calculate offsets or rates.
messages.limits.lossy: This format is lossy and cannot preserve independent overlapping regions, broadcast layout, or all DRCS behaviour.
messages.limits.tlv: TLV/MMTP support is limited to recognized closed-caption assets; other assets are retained as raw evidence and are not guessed.
messages.route.mpegTsTtml: MPEG-TS private PES / ARIB-TTML candidate route
messages.route.tlv: Experimental TLV/MMTP route · raw evidence first
messages.limits.restart: Checkpoint data preserves diagnostics, but resuming currently restarts from a trusted beginning because native decoder state is not serializable.
messages.limits.title: Conversion limits
messages.limits.selectedTitle: Some selected formats cannot preserve every feature
messages.limits.format.srt: SRT carries timing and plain text only. Screen position, colour, ruby layout, DRCS graphics, and broadcast gaiji glyphs cannot be stored. Accessibility descriptions remain as ordinary text.
messages.limits.format.webvtt: The current WebVTT compatibility export retains timing and text, but cannot reproduce the ARIB caption plane, DRCS graphics, or complete ruby layout.
messages.limits.faithful: ASS and TTML preserve parallel regions, but neither format is a byte-for-byte ARIB archive. Use JSON archive plus raw data for evidence-grade retention.
messages.settings.typographyDescription: Define explicit fallback for multilingual task data and ARIB caption review.
messages.settings.uiFallbackDescription: The default stack prioritizes installed CJK fonts. This is for UI labels and diagnostics, not broadcast caption glyph decoding.

messages.settings.outputDescription: New tasks begin with these choices; a task can still override them before export.
messages.settings.faithfulDescription: ASS and TTML retain parallel caption regions. JSON is the archival event route.
messages.settings.timelineDescription: Automatic repair keeps minor recording discontinuities from producing invalid intervals.
messages.settings.playerDescription: Video stays out of the WebView. ResubWinny uses an in-process libmpv native surface for preview.

messages.settings.previewControlsDescription: Space pauses or resumes. Left and right arrows seek five seconds. The preview uses hardware decoding when mpv supports it.
messages.settings.fallbackPreview: Fallback preview — missing glyphs are never silently replaced by a generic icon.
